ref.description: The full ref name whose runs to cancel, such as refs/heads/main.

pull.description: The dev.knotless.pull record whose runs to cancel.

repo.description: The repository, which is the owner's.

workflow.description: The name of the one workflow whose runs to cancel.

main.description: Kept in the account of the repository's owner, keyed `<repo key>.<tid>`. A runner acts on the requests in the owner's account, newer than the last it acted on, and on no one else's: it cancels its runs of the ref or the pull going or waiting for their turn when it reads the request, even those of a workflow whose runs finish, and files their checks as cancelled. A merge queue's batches are not a ref's runs. Naming neither a ref nor a pull asks for nothing. With a workflow, only that workflow's runs are cancelled.

description: A repository owner's request that its runners cancel the runs of a ref or a pull still going.
